integrity: Ordinary combinatorial proof and finite reproducibility checks are provided; literature comparisons do not establish exhaustive priority.
scientific_limitations: The nonequivariant wedge phenomenon follows from existing forest polyhedral-join methods. The added explicit weighted double-star multiplicities and canonical integral natural-symmetry modules have only been compared with accessible relevant literature. The result concerns clique fibers, p,q >= 2 and the natural fiber-preserving group, not all abstract automorphisms. The orbit-space result is rational, not integral. Modular examples corroborate but do not establish the general proof.
title: Integral homology lattices of clique-expanded double stars
